title: The char-p transfer of #lacBad is gated by the SAME +-1-relation height as the BGK energy -- one threshold s* governs both faces
reduced_to: The OBJECT-level unification is correct and is the salvageable, useful content: BOTH char-p transfers really are the single cyclotomic predicate RelationFreeAtLevel(q, mu, s) := no nonzero {-1,0,1}-vector c of support <= s has sum_j c_j zeta^j = 0 in F_q while being nonzero in C (a genuine = non-char-0 relation of 2^mu-th roots). Count face: LamLeungAntipodalTightness.antipodal_invariant_of_vanishing_sum's hypothesis hindep IS exactly '{-1,0,1}-combinations of {1,...,zeta^{N-1}} do not vanish'; its failure mod q = a non-antipodal vanishing subset = the #lacBad defect carrier (the c_j = [j in A] - [j+N in A] vector built in that proof). Energy face: E_r^{Fp} > E_r^{char0} = a signed 2r-relation of roots vanishing mod q beyond Wick negation-pairings. Both are {-1,0,1}-lattice-relations-of-2^mu-th-roots-mod-q -- the shared-object claim is real and supported by proven in-tree lemmas (lacBad_smul_closed, MinimalVanishingReduction.lam_leung_iff_minimal). The honest reduced statement: 'the two char-p residuals share ONE relation-supply object', NOT 'one threshold s* governs both'.
wall: W-anomaly / W-BGK: the ENERGY face's relation-exclusion depth (2r ~ 2 log q) is exactly the open Bourgain-Shkredov/cyclotomic-lattice-collision wall, declared VACUOUS at prize scale by Frontier/CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean (clean range (2r)^{phi(n)} < p gives only r = O(1) at phi(2^mu)=n/2, far below r ~ log q). RelationFreeAtLevel at s* ~ 2 log n is the SHALLOW (count) regime only; it does not reach the deep regime the energy needs.
evidence: Exact integer arithmetic over dyadic mu_n of F_q* in the prize regime (n in {8,16,32}, n=2^mu a PROPER subgroup, q prime = 1 mod n, two primes per n: q ~ n^4.5 prize-shaped + a smaller q ~ n^3 small enough for exact energy DP). Probe: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C033_unified_relation_threshold.py. (1) OBJECT match CONFIRMED: at n=16, q=4129 the COUNT face's minimal GENUINE {-1,0,1} relation (vanishes mod q, nonzero in C; the char-0 reduction zeta^{n/2}=-1 was verified exactly, char-0 E_2(mu_4)=36, E_2(mu_8)=168 matching brute force over C) appears at support 7, and the ENERGY face's first non-char-0 collision (E_r^{Fp} > E_r^{char0}, exact closed-form char-0 energy via per-residue-class sign-balance) appears at r=4 i.e. signed length 2r=8 -- nearby, both genuine {-1,0,1}-root-relations mod q. So the two faces DO draw on the same relation supply (the connection's core insight). (2) THRESHOLD match REFUTED (the decisive computation): in the TRUE prize regime q*eps* ~ n (q ~ n*2^128, eps* = 2^-128), s* = 2 log2(q eps*)/H(rho) ~ 2 log2(n)/H(1/4) = 2.465 log2(n) -- a SHALLOW length -- whereas the energy face needs moment depth r ~ log q, i.e. relation length 2r ~ 2 log2(q) = 2*beta*log2(n). The ratio energy/s* = beta*H(rho) = 4.5*0.811 = 3.65, a FIXED factor ~beta apart (constant across n=16..2^32, exact table in probe), NOT 1. Hence RelationFreeAtLevel(q,mu,s*) governs ONLY the count/floor face; it is strictly weaker than what GaussianEnergyBound needs. The attack-plan claim 'prove DyadicLacunaryFloor AND GaussianEnergyBound BOTH follow from RelationFreeAtLevel at s*' is therefore FALSE: only the floor follows. (3) Prize-shaped corroboration: at the large prize primes (q ~ n^4.5), NO genuine relation and NO non-antipodal subset were found up to support 8 (the defect carriers there have support > s*-shallow-search reach), consistent with relation-freeness holding at shallow lengths while the deep energy regime is untouched -- matching CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold's own vacuity admission (lines 56-62) and the prior C019/C022 findings.
honest_note: Two-sided, no closure. CORRECT and genuinely useful: (i) the OBJECT unification -- count char-p transfer and energy char-p transfer are the SAME {-1,0,1}-cyclotomic-relation-mod-q supply -- is a real, previously-separated-residual sharpening, and is even formalizable as the single decidable Prop RelationFreeAtLevel (the in-tree hindep of LamLeungAntipodalTightness and the Wick-defect of E_r are both instances); the cited Lean lemmas (antipodal_invariant_of_vanishing_sum, lacBad_smul_closed, lam_leung_iff_minimal) are genuine and axiom-clean as read. OVERCLAIMED and the decisive correction: 'ONE threshold s* = 2 log(q eps*)/H(rho) governs BOTH faces' is too strong. The count face is governed at the shallow length s* ~ 2.5 log n; the energy face is governed at the deep length 2 log q ~ 9 log n; these differ by the fixed factor beta*H(rho) ~ 3.65, so a single s* cannot gate both, and proving relation-freeness at s* (the in-tree relation-free probe's reach) discharges the floor but NOT GaussianEnergyBound. The energy face is the full open BGK / cyclotomic-lattice-collision wall (CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold vacuous at phi=n/2). So C033 correctly UNIFIES THE OBJECT but mis-unifies THE SCALE; it welds the energy face back to W-BGK/W-anomaly. This is the same depth-wall as C019 (PARTIAL) restated from the count/energy-symmetry angle, plus a new exact threshold-ratio (beta*H(rho)). Caveats: energy exact DP feasible only for q <= ~60000 (n=16 q=4129 only among tested); prize-scale energy infeasible (asserted via the depth argument + CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold, not computed); n=32 genuine-relation exhaustive search did not finish in the time box (capped); char-0 energy closed form verified against brute-force only for mu_4/mu_8; I did not build the oleans (axiom-cleanliness of cited lemmas asserted from in-file #print axioms + read proofs, not re-run). Recommend a DISPROOF_LOG one-liner: 'C033 object-unification OK (count & energy = same {-1,0,1}-relation-mod-q supply) but single-threshold s* REFUTED: count gated at s*~2.5 log n, energy at 2 log q, ratio beta*H(rho)~3.65; relation-free at s* gives DyadicLacunaryFloor only, NOT GaussianEnergyBound (deep BGK wall remains).'
